intent: Guided LOG flow: user picks element → walks through these checkpoints in order → marks pass/fail + photo on fail. The check_mode flag enables a different UI from free-form defect entry.

items.description: Stains (exclude stains that can be easily removed)
items.pass_criteria: Visual — no permanent staining visible under normal lighting
Visual — tiles / planks / slabs visually aligned
Visual — joint widths and grouting even
Visual — no surface damage on finished floor
Measured — deviation ≤ 6mm over 1.2m straightedge

items.description: Hollowness (for tiled floor as long as it is hollow)
items.pass_criteria: Tap test — no hollow sound on any tile

items.description: Damages - Cracks, Open veins felt with hand (>0.5mm width and >100mm length)
items.pass_criteria: Visual + feel — no cracks or open veins >0.5mm wide AND >100mm long
Visual — no chipped timber anywhere on floor; no warpage for timber
Visual — zero delamination spots on timber flooring

items.description: Lippage for tiled floors (felt by touch)
items.pass_criteria: Visual + feel — tile edges flush with neighbours
Visual — no visible cracks on plastered surface
Visual — uniform finish across wall area
Visual — elements aligned (skirting, corners, features)
Visual — joint widths and profiles even
Visual — no surface damage
Measured — deviation ≤ 6mm over 1.2m spirit level
Measured — deviation ≤ 8mm over 300mm

items.description: Hollowness (for tiled wall as long as it is hollow)
items.pass_criteria: Tap test — solid sound on all tiles

items.description: Damages - Visible cracks on finished walls OR open veins felt with hand (>0.5mm width and >100mm length)
items.pass_criteria: Visual + feel — no cracks >0.5mm wide AND >100mm long
Visual — zero delamination spots on timber finishing

items.description: Stains (exclude stains that can be easily removed)
items.pass_criteria: Visual — no permanent staining
Visual — uniform finish, paintwork with good opacity, no brush marks
Visual — joints consistent, aligned and neat

items.description: Damages - Hairline cracks on plastered ceiling, chip, dent, scratches
items.pass_criteria: Visual — no surface defects on plastered ceiling

items.description: Damages - Cracked ceiling board (>0.5mm width and 100mm length)
items.pass_criteria: Visual — no cracks >0.5mm wide AND >100mm length
Visual — uniform gap around door leaf, between leaf and frame, no visible gaps within leaf or at mitre joints
Visual — clean surface

items.description: Fitting - movement, difficulty in open/closing, loose, functionally deficient
items.pass_criteria: Function test — ease in opening, closing and locking; no squeaky sound; no rattling when closed
Measured — alignment / level with walls ≤ 3mm/m or 1.2m spirit level; door frame and leaf flush; corners at right angles
Visual — no cracks in timber leaf or frame

items.description: Accessories Defects - Missing/broken/improper fixing of accessories, corroded accessories etc
items.pass_criteria: Visual + function — lock sets with good fit, no corrosion, no missing or defective accessories
Visual — uniform sealant and frame gaps, neat joints between window and wall, consistent mitre joints
Visual — frame and pane clean

items.description: Fitting - movement, difficulty in open/closing, loose, functionally deficient
items.pass_criteria: Function test — ease in opening, closing and locking; no rainwater leakage; no squeaky sound

items.description: Damages - Cracked/chipped frame, cracked/chipped/broken window panes
items.pass_criteria: Visual — intact frame and glass

items.description: Accessories Defects - Missing/broken/improper fixing of accessories, corroded accessories etc
items.pass_criteria: Visual + function — handles, locks, hinges, screws present, secure, corrosion-free; countersunk screws levelled and flushed
Visual — consistent joint width, neat joint, no visible gap, welding joints grounded or flushed
Visual — leveled and straight
Visual — consistent in colour tone
Visual — aligned (squared, level, plumb as designed)
Visual — clean surface

items.description: Fitting - movement, difficulty in open/closing, loose, functionally deficient
items.pass_criteria: Function test — functional, secure and safe

items.description: Damages - Cracked WC, cracked/chipped/broken shower screen, mirror and any glass items
items.pass_criteria: Visual — no cracks, chips, breaks

items.description: Accessories Defects - Missing/broken/improper fixing of accessories, corroded accessories etc
items.pass_criteria: Visual + function — present, secure, corrosion-free, no visible damages
Visual — leveled and straight; pipes aligned horizontally / vertically and parallel to building surface; floor trap top lower than surrounding floor
Visual — aligned as designed
Visual — clean cover plates and fixtures

items.description: Fitting - movement, difficulty in open/closing, loose, functionally deficient
items.pass_criteria: Function test — functional, secure and safe; no chokage at gully / floor trap; no leakage at pipe joints and fittings

items.pass_criteria: Visual + function — intact housing; fan coil unit dry under operation

items.pass_criteria: Visual + function — present, secure, corrosion-free; brackets firmly secured and adequately spaced for pipes; no exposed wiring

changelog.summary: Initial set — ~47 checkpoints covering 7 IF elements across 1X/2X/3X tiers, derived from Table 3 defect list.

Descriptions updated to verbatim defect-condition wording per project reference table; pass_criteria preserved as inspection-method copy. Tier reassignments: chk_flr_5 / chk_wal_6 / chk_wal_7 (2X→1X), chk_dor_4 (3X→2X). Removed chk_mep_1 (M&E aesthetic joints/gaps — not tracked per project reference); total now 50 (was 51). Floor 3X retains separate Cracks/Open veins (chk_flr_7) and Chipped timber (chk_flr_8) — not merged.
